scope: User authorizes GPU7 B continuation to T10 conditional on exceeding standard LoRM at T3.

gate.checkpoint: B final T3 only, no best checkpoint selection
gate.condition: B T3 correct > 2724 on the same 3000 images; equality does not pass
gate.raw: Report raw alongside primary; do not add a new raw gate or tune readout.

continuation.from: B own fully committed and qualified T3, preserving its model, heads, history, RNG and all three historical evaluations
continuation.output: runs/ten, separate from immutable runs/main T3 artifacts
continuation.scientific_changes: Only total task horizon and output/continuation metadata; unchanged method, selection, lambda/kappa, optimizer, split, seed and readout.
continuation.diagnostic_windows: Apply the same client0 round0 first/last and round4 last diagnostic windows to T4-T10.
continuation.clock: Continuation shares original B started1793032083.5549312 / deadline1793117583.5549312; no clock reset.
continuation.storage: Aggregate existing B root plus continuation output; original 8GB limit/6GB write-stop retained.
continuation.resources: Verify GPU7 available memory before continuation; do not move to other GPU or stop other jobs.

if_not_passed: Deliver complete B T3 result and do not extend B to T10.
delivery: Always retain/report B T3; if extended, additionally deliver B full T1-T10 raw/centered matrices, LoRM comparison, diagnostics/cost, and actual T10 full 10000-image checkpoint reload. Keep the single heartbeat until all authorized runs are delivered.
interpretation: This is a performance-conditioned horizon extension on the existing evaluation set, not independent held-out confirmation; disclose the conditional selection.
